/cloud/v1/environments/{id}/activation: A Kong route, which rewrites it to the sidecar path /cloud/environments/{id}/activation. It is not a sidecar endpoint.
/dxp/v1/installations/{id}/activation: A Kong route, which rewrites it to the sidecar path /dxp/installations/{id}/activation. It is not a sidecar endpoint.
